mapper.select: SELECT route_id, stop_id, stop_sequence FROM public.route_stops ORDER BY route_id, stop_sequence

SELECT rs.route_id, rs.stop_id, s.stop_name, s.longitude, s.latitude, rs.stop_sequence FROM public.route_stops rs JOIN public.stops s ON rs.stop_id = s.stop_id WHERE rs.route_id = #{routeId} ORDER BY rs.stop_sequence
